name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
summary: A seated wrist movement with an overhand grip that trains the forearm extensors on the top of the forearm. Use light loads.
setup: Sit holding a light barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench with the wrists hanging off the edge.
Keep your forearms still and relaxed.
execution: Lower the bar by letting the wrists bend toward the floor under control.
Extend the wrists to lift the bar as high as you can.
mistakes: Using too much weight and losing control: pick a load that lets you move through the full range.
Lifting the forearms off the support: keep them anchored.
Bouncing at the bottom: pause and lift smoothly.
Rushing the reps: keep a steady 2-second lift and lower.
